argv: echo HOST; hostname; echo UP; uptime; echo MEM; free -h; echo CPU; ps -eo pid,pcpu,pmem,rss,comm --sort=-pcpu | head -n 18; echo PREV; journalctl -b -1 -p err --no-pager -n 30 || true
intention: Identify what locked the machine, including the previous boot if it was power-cycled
consequence: Read-only receipt of top processes now and error lines from the previous boot
